name: Lucidity
description:
Lucidity connects Claude to your clients' ad, analytics, crm, and commerce data. It normalizes across sources so a conversion means the same thing everywhere, and cross-channel metrics resolve to a single blended CPA and CTR before anything reads them.

Connected sources: Meta Ads, Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok, GA4, Google Search Console, Shopify, and Klaviyo. Data syncs daily.

The structure is the reusable part. Build a report once, in whatever shape you need, and the next period is a rerun instead of a rebuild: same sections, same styling, new data. Reports carry their own narrative and ranked recommendations, each tied to a campaign and a number, and go out as a web report, a slide deck, a PDF, or a Word doc.

Things to ask:
Build a paid media report for Acme covering last month.
Rerun the Acme report with July data.
Compare Meta and Google Ads efficiency for the last two quarters.
Which campaigns drove Shopify revenue in June, and what changed from May?

Lucidity reads from your connected ad, analytics, and commerce accounts and never writes back to them. It does not create, edit, or optimize ads, and does not manage bidding. The only thing the connector writes is your saved report structures.

Requires a Lucidity account. Connect one account and build your first report free.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Lucidity to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Lucidity to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.lucidityanalytics.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Lucidity MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lucidity provides these MCP tools: lucidity_delete_template, lucidity_get_performance_summary, lucidity_get_schema, lucidity_list_templates, lucidity_query_data, lucidity_run_template, and lucidity_save_template.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Lucidity?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Lucidity in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Lucidity requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Lucidity is developed by Lucidity LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
